description: Check the server is up and see which supply sources are currently answering. Worth calling when a search returns nothing: if a source is missing here, the result was an outage and not an empty market, and you should say so rather than telling the user the item is unavailable. Free, instant, no side effects. Protocol v1.0 §8.2.
name: demand.health

degraded.description: True when one or more supply sources are failing.

status.description: "ok" when the server can answer searches.

supply_sources.description: Supply sources currently reachable. A short list means degraded matching, not an empty market.

title: Health + supply sources
